statement: Build a single-file website (plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript) for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop, so coffee lovers and nearby office staff can see the menu with prices, check the opening hours, find the address and pre-order for pickup at the shop.
audience: Coffee lovers and office staff nearby, mostly on phones, who today cannot see the menu or order ahead.
standards: Works on phones: no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Every fact shown exactly as given in the brief
rules: The address is shown as text with no embedded map
Customers collect the order at the shop
The page does not show a phone number for the shop
done_when: The page shows the name Brew Lab
The page shows the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, with no embedded map
The page shows a menu of seven items with these prices in rupees: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120
The page shows the opening hours 7 am to 10 pm, every day
The page has a pre-order form with the fields name, phone, items and pickup time
The form sends the order to hello@brewlab.example
The page says customers collect the order at the shop and that no online payment is taken
The page does not show a phone number for the shop
The layout works on phones, with no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
Every in-page link goes to a section that exists
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
facts: 20 pre-orders a week within the first month
